track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ek4 and dwells most on G in Gusheye Chahargah. The line peaks at Ak4 (402.2 Hz) at 0:28.3. It closes on the tonic (Fs4 → Ak4 → G4 → G4 → Ek4 → G4).
